response.description: Announcing SQL MCP Server, our Model Context Protocol (MCP) connector for production databases. SQL MCP Server is a feature rich component of data API builder (DAB) that gives you a simple, predictable, secure way to bring AI agents into your data workflows without compromising the database or relying on natural language. SQL MCP Server runs locally, on premises, or in any cloud as a containerized service. Learn more.
response.title: Public Preview: SQL MCP Server
